scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: The agent nailed the root cause with quantified evidence, correctly distinguished cascading from genuine errors, cited the exact fsproj lines and an existing conditional-include precedent, and proposed a concrete fix. Only blemishes are a stray inconsistency ('~10 real FS0039' vs the counted 61) and two wasted shell calls.

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 lacks these APIs, hence FS0039
Noted net10.0 FS0001 type mismatches as separate real problem
